title: Ancestors and Teachers Part 1
speaker: Kanho Chris Burkhart
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of approaching Zen's history with curiosity and respect, rather than seeking to verify historical accuracy. Rather than focusing on tracing a traditional lineage, Kanho Chris Burkhart encourages us to focus on how the Dharma continues to speak to us in the present moment, and to recognize and honor the teachings and experiences of all teachers, regardless of gender. This approach allows us to engage with the Dharma in a way that is authentic and personal, rather than getting caught up in disputes and power struggles of the past. By doing so, we can tap into the timeless wisdom of Zen and allow its teachings to guide us in our daily lives.
